Difficulty
Civilian cars: bumping them dents you less than a fight does, but wrecking one costs 300 points.

Interstate 80, dusk. Overtake or take down the cars marked with a gold diamond and the weapons truck rolls in. Get behind it, line up with the ramp and drive inside to pick your gear. Crashes dent your car; repair stops on the right shoulder fix it.

THE OPPOSITION

Blade RiderMotorcycle. Rides alongside, punching and kicking Road Rash style (some carry a blade).
EnforcerSedan with a ram bar. Flashes hazards, then side-rams.
ShredderVan. Blocks your lane and drops mines.
JuggernautBig rig. Rolls barrels off the back.
ViperCorvette. Gets in front and fires rear rockets.
RaptorLamborghini. Charges in from behind and sideswipes.
RipsawHeavy armoured brute with circular saws on both sides. Slams you toward the rail and grinds.
DeadeyeMuscle car with a roof turret. Sits ahead and fires aimed bursts.
Road HogWide armoured bruiser. Shrugs off bullets and shoulders you into the rail. Ram it, missile it or pinch it.
ScorcherFlamethrower car. Slides in front and torches its wake.
